name: Cupriferous-Dirge
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a subterranean ocean, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
